scope: Read push trigger definitions solely to prevent documentation publication executing existing campaigns/tests

push_workflows.definition:
name: MXM O04 safe policy denial probe
run-name: MXM O04 policy rejection fixture no secrets no writes
on:
  push:
    branches: [mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1]
    paths: ['.github/workflows/mxm-o04-policy-denial-probe-20261016.yml']
permissions: {}
jobs:
  harmless_if_policy_fails:
    if: github.run_attempt == 1 && github.ref_name == 'mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps:
      - run: echo POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED_SAFE_FIXTURE_ONLY

# O04 staging reception 20261016: safe fixture only; historical code never rerun.

name: MXM approved P0-P4 remediation verification only
run-name: MXM REST29 targeted receipts ${{ github.sha }}
on:
  push:
    branches: [mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1]
    paths:
      - 'research_core_v4/remediation_p0_p4_20261015/rest29_v3.py'
      - 'research_core_v4/remediation_p0_p4_20261015/test_rest29_v3.py'
      - '.github/workflows/mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  targeted_residual_controls:
    if: github.run_attempt == 1 && github.ref_name == 'mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
      - name: Existing hash-locked dependencies, no private key
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes -r research_core_v4/remediation_p0_p4_20261015/requirements.lock
      - name: Only residual and affected workflow-policy controls
        run: python3 -m research_core_v4.remediation_p0_p4_20261015.test_rest29_v3
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: mxm-rest29-targeted-${{ github.sha }}
          path: verification/rest29-tests.json
          if-no-files-found: error
  owner_remaining_receipts:
    needs: targeted_residual_controls
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
      - name: Existing hash-locked readback dependencies before key access
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes -r research_core_v4/remediation_p0_p4_20261015/requirements.lock
      - name: Existing OWNER conflict, parent-ledger and historical impact readback only
        run: python3 -m research_core_v4.remediation_p0_p4_20261015.rest29_v3
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          MXM_V4_INPUT_BUNDLE_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM: ${{ secrets.MXM_V4_INPUT_BUNDLE_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM }}
          OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: '1'
          OMP_NUM_THREADS: '1'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: mxm-rest29-owner-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            verification/rest29-summary.json
            verification/rest29-attestation.json
            verification/rest29-reader-routes.csv
            verification/rest29-owner-investigation.mxmenc
          if-no-files-found: error

name: MXM O04 isolated fencing evidence only
run-name: MXM O04 fencing tests and GET-only rights ${{ github.sha }}
on:
  push:
    branches: [mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1]
    paths:
      - 'research_core_v4/writer_fencing_o04_20261016/**'
      - '.github/workflows/mxm-o04-fencing-evidence-20261016.yml'
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
jobs:
  isolated_fence_and_authority_evidence:
    if: github.run_attempt == 1 && github.ref_name == 'mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
      - name: Only synthetic local Git concurrency and fencing controls
        run: python3 -m research_core_v4.writer_fencing_o04_20261016.test_git_fence_lab
      - name: All fetched heads tags and historical source versions without executing legacy code
        run: python3 -m research_core_v4.writer_fencing_o04_20261016.inventory verification/o04-writer-inventory.json
      - name: GET-only GitHub authority and stopped checkpoint evidence
        run: python3 -m research_core_v4.writer_fencing_o04_20261016.probe
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: mxm-o04-fencing-${{ github.sha }}
          path: verification/o04-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
  live_synthetic_git_cas:
    needs: isolated_fence_and_authority_evidence
    if: github.run_attempt == 1 && github.ref_name == 'mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
    outputs:
      proof_ref: ${{ steps.live.outputs.proof_ref }}
      candidate: ${{ steps.live.outputs.candidate }}
      expected: ${{ steps.live.outputs.expected }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
      - name: Real GitHub CAS on a new run-scoped synthetic ref only
        id: live
        run: python3 -m research_core_v4.writer_fencing_o04_20261016.live_proof
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: mxm-o04-live-cas-${{ github.sha }}
          path: verification/o04-live-proof.json
          if-no-files-found: error
  live_ungranted_token_denied:
    needs: live_synthetic_git_cas
    if: github.run_attempt == 1 && github.ref_name == 'mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 1}
      - name: Read-only token cannot move even the synthetic proof ref
        run: python3 -m research_core_v4.writer_fencing_o04_20261016.live_proof --unauthorized
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PROOF_REF: ${{ needs.live_synthetic_git_cas.outputs.proof_ref }}
          CANDIDATE: ${{ needs.live_synthetic_git_cas.outputs.candidate }}
          EXPECTED: ${{ needs.live_synthetic_git_cas.outputs.expected }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: mxm-o04-ungranted-${{ github.sha }}
          path: verification/o04-unauthorized.json
          if-no-files-found: error

name: MXM O04 staging protocol and principal isolation reception
run-name: MXM O04 STAGING ONLY ${{ github.sha }}
on:
  push:
    branches: [mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1]
    paths:
      - 'research_core_v4/writer_staging_o04_20261016/**'
      - '.github/workflows/mxm-o04-writer-staging-20261016.yml'
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
jobs:
  read_only_regression:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor_id == '322088485' && github.run_attempt == 1 && github.ref == 'refs/heads/mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1' && github.sha == github.event.after
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: {contents: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 1}
      - run: python3 -m research_core_v4.writer_staging_o04_20261016.test_protocol
  synthetic_protocol:
    needs: read_only_regression
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor_id == '322088485' && github.run_attempt == 1 && github.ref == 'refs/heads/mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1' && github.sha == github.event.after
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    outputs:
      proof_ref: ${{ steps.proof.outputs.proof_ref }}
      candidate: ${{ steps.proof.outputs.candidate }}
      expected: ${{ steps.proof.outputs.expected }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 1}
      - name: Staging only real receive-pack CAS and closed acceptance gate
        id: proof
        run: python3 -m research_core_v4.writer_staging_o04_20261016.live_stage
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: mxm-o04-stage-protocol-${{ github.sha }}
          path: verification/o04-stage-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
  readonly_probe:
    needs: synthetic_protocol
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor_id == '322088485' && github.run_attempt == 1 && github.ref == 'refs/heads/mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1' && github.sha == github.event.after
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 1}
      - run: python3 -m research_core_v4.writer_staging_o04_20261016.live_stage --readonly
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PROOF_REF: ${{ needs.synthetic_protocol.outputs.proof_ref }}
          CANDIDATE: ${{ needs.synthetic_protocol.outputs.candidate }}
          EXPECTED: ${{ needs.synthetic_protocol.outputs.expected }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: mxm-o04-stage-readonly-${{ github.sha }}
          path: verification/o04-stage-readonly.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
  write_without_acceptor_role:
    needs: [synthetic_protocol, readonly_probe]
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor_id == '322088485' && github.run_attempt == 1 && github.ref == 'refs/heads/mxm-remediation-p0-p4-20261015-v1' && github.sha == github.event.after
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 1}
      - name: Expected NO_GO counterexample on synthetic ref only
        run: python3 -m research_core_v4.writer_staging_o04_20261016.live_stage --write-bypass
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PROOF_REF: ${{ needs.synthetic_protocol.outputs.proof_ref }}
          CANDIDATE: ${{ needs.synthetic_protocol.outputs.candidate }}
          EXPECTED: ${{ needs.synthetic_protocol.outputs.expected }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: mxm-o04-stage-write-bypass-${{ github.sha }}
          path: verification/o04-stage-write-bypass.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
